environment.description: Same application deployed in a hardened container. ImageMagick is configured with a custom policy.xml that sets resource limits and disables specific coders. The container also runs with a custom seccomp profile that restricts certain syscalls. Additionally, a read-only filesystem is mounted on sensitive paths.

config.imagemagick_policy_xml: <policymap><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="MVG"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="SVG"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="MSL"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="TEXT"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="SHOW"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="WIN"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="PLT"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="URL"/><policy domain="coder" rights="none" pattern="EPHEMERAL"/><policy domain="delegate" rights="none" pattern="*"/><policy domain="filter" rights="none" pattern="*"/><policy domain="path" rights="none" pattern="@*"/><policy domain="resource" name="width" value="4096"/><policy domain="resource" name="height" value="4096"/></policymap>
config.seccomp_profile: custom profile blocking execve for child processes spawned by convert binary via PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS and restricted clone/fork for subprocesses of ImageMagick delegates
config.filesystem: /etc/shadow read-denied via AppArmor deny rule, /proc/self/environ read-denied
